book.name: MADIU
book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn MADIU

content: Duwen Kadaudok kan me Sises Krais ketin Ipwisang
Iet irekidien dih kan me sapwellimen Sises Krais, me kisehn kadaudok en Depit oh kisehn kadaudok en Eipraam.
Iet irekidien dih kan sang Eipraam oh lel Nanmwarki Depit: Eipraam me semen Aisek; Aisek me semen Seikop; Seikop me semen Suda oh rie ko.
Suda me semen Peres oh Sera (inara Damar); Peres me semen Esron; Esron me semen Ram;
Ram me semen Aminadap; Aminadap me semen Nahson; Nahson me semen Salmon;
Salmon me semen Pohas (me ine Reap); Pohas me semen Oped (me ine Rud); Oped me semen Sehsi;
a Sehsi me semen Nanmwarki Depit. Iet irekidien dih kan sang Nanmwarki Depit lel ahnsou me mehn Israel kan kalipilipala nan wehin Papilon: Depit me semen Solomon, sang en Uraia eh pwoud.
Solomon me semen Reopoham; Reopoham me semen Apaisa; Apaisa me semen Asa;
Asa me semen Seosopat; Seosopat me semen Soram; Soram me semen Usaia;
Usaia me semen Sodam; Sodam me semen Ahas; Ahas me semen Esekaia;
Esekaia me semen Manase; Manase me semen Amon; Amon me semen Sosaia;
Sosaia me semen Sekonaia oh rie ko ahnsou me mehn Suhs ako sellahng Papilon.
Iet irekidien dih kan mwurin ar sellahng Papilon lel ni ipwidien Sises: Sehoakim me semen Sealtiel; Sealtiel me semen Serupapel;
Serupapel me semen Apiud; Apiud me semen Elaiakim; Elaiakim me semen Asor;
Asor me semen Sadok; Sadok me semen Akim; Akim me semen Eliud;
Eliud me semen Eliesar; Eliesar me semen Madan; Madan me semen Seikop;
Seikop me semen Sosep, en Mery eh pwoud, me kaipwiedi Sises, me mwarenki Mesaia.
Eri, dih eisek pahieu mie sang Eipraam lel Depit; a sang Depit lel ahnsou me mehn Suhs ako sellahng Papilon, pil dih eisik pahieu; a sang ahnsowo lel ipwidien Mesaiao, pil dih eisek pahieu.
Duwen Ipwidien Sises Krais
Eri, iet duwen ipwidien Sises Krais: ine Mery me kisinihniong Sosep, ira ahpw saikinte pwopwoudida, e pehmada duwen eh ketin liseian ahpw sang Ngehn Sarawi.
Eh werek, Sosep, ni eh ohl lelepek oh pwung oh sohte men kahdsuwedihla Mery mwohn aramas akan, e ahpw lemehda en mweisang ni rir.

Eri, ni eh medemedewe met, iet tohnleng en Kaun-o men ahpw pwarodo nan eh meir oh mahsanihong, “Sosep kisehn kadaudok en Depit, ke dehr perki ale Mery omw werek, pwe wahn nan kupwure e ahpikihda Ngehn Sarawi.
E pahn ketin naitikihada sapwellime pwutak emen me ke pahn kihong mware Sises— pwe e pahn ketin kapitasang sapwellime aramas akan nan diparail kan.”
Eri, mepwukat koaros wiawiher pwe en pweida me Kaun-o mahsanihong soukohpo pwe en lohkihda, ni eh mahsanih,
“Meipwono pahn liseianda oh naitikihda nah pwutak emen, me re pahn kamwarehki Emanuel” (me wehwehki, “Koht kin ketiket rehtail”).
Sosep eri pirida, e ahpw kapwaiada me tohnleng en Kaun-o mahsanih. E ahpw ale Mery oh pwoudikihda.
Eri, Sosep sohte kapwaiada nsenen pwopwoud ong Mery mwohn eh naitikihada sapwellime pwutako. Sosep eri kihong mware, Sises.
